fields.finding: The printed densification slope exceeds E=40 MPa. Converting all plotted total strains with epsilon_p=epsilon_total-sigma/E gives nonmonotone plastic strain. The conditional model retains the monotone portion and explicitly extrapolates its last hardening slope.
fields.consequence: Any path using extrapolation has material uncertainty beyond plot digitization. Full densification cannot be claimed fitted.

claim: The printed densification slope exceeds E=40 MPa. Converting all plotted total strains with epsilon_p=epsilon_total-sigma/E gives nonmonotone plastic strain. The conditional model retains the monotone portion and explicitly extrapolates its last hardening slope.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
